title: Goal Rush!
description: One ball. Zero chill. A chaotic arcade soccer game: curl, power and trick shots, dash tackles, special abilities and random Chaos events like Giant Ball, Banana Field and Reverse Controls. Concede and go into Rage Mode. Quick Match 1v1 to 3v3, Chaos Cup with a ranked leaderboard, Golden Goal, Penalty Panic and Party Mode. Slow-mo goal replays, funny captions and unlockable kits. Free, no download, works on phone.
